_comment: S11 Workstream B (the moonshot active tracker): = sitl3_lanes_vision.json geometry (convoy_3lane world, 3 diverging straight lanes, save_marker_frames ON) but each drone runs the track_convoy phase instead of sentry_scan — it locks ONE car's unique ArUco id (track_marker_ids) and bearing-pursues the moving car, keeping it under the nadir camera, then gives up cleanly on budget and lands. DRONE<->CAR: alpha->7, bravo->23, charlie->88 (per-drone zone.track_convoy.track_marker_ids). approach_enabled true: sim is exactly where open-loop translation is PROVEN (gate-E discipline keeps it OFF on real HULA until move/rotate accuracy is measured onsite). Pursuit is bearing-based (Rotate to center on bearing_deg, then Move FORWARD), bounded by max_chase_cm (open-loop runaway cap) and investigate_budget_s (wall-clock give-up). Run via sim/run_vision.sh track3 (PX4_GZ_WORLD=convoy_3lane + a straight slow convoy on 7/23/88). Endpoints/ports/timeouts identical to sitl3_lanes_vision.json. TUNED (2026-06-10, after the first VM run lost bravo's car ~16s into the chase): bravo band 1.7->2.0 for a bigger, more forgiving footprint nearer charlie's working 2.2 (the 1.7 footprint walked off its still car under the open-loop FORWARD steps; bands must stay DISTINCT per drone = the sitl vertical-separation guard, so 2.0 not 2.2); approach_cm 40->25 + track_dwell_s 1.0 (gentler steps, re-observe more between moves) + lost_timeout_s 4->8 (a brief blip no longer drops the lock) on all 3. VM-TUNE on the box: CONVOY_LINEAR (car speed vs the drone's chase rate), approach_cm/max_step_deg/track_dwell_s (chase aggression vs lockstep RTF ~0.86), max_chase_cm (arena size). lead_gain stays 0 (azimuth lead needs onsite calibration); core is fixed-step bearing pursuit.
